name: HOLY BREAKER!2 -THE WISH IN THE NIGHT OF THE STAR TALERS.-
source:
Sequel to Holy Breaker!, this VN will be first sold at Comiket 89. A few months after Tsukumo met the jet-black witch Minase, a new scheme began to take hold just when he had healed from the life-or-death battle. The gears of the world began to turn with his meeting with the German visitor Saten and subsequent clash with the ‘zero’ spiritual user Licht.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/01/05/january-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是《HOLY BREAKER!》的续作，首次在Comic Market 89发售。九十九与漆黑魔女水濑相遇、从生死之战中恢复数月后，新的阴谋开始酝酿。随着德国访客萨腾出现，以及随后与“零”灵术使用者利希特发生冲突，世界的齿轮开始转动。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/01/05/january-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
